title: The impact of ESG performance on OFDI mode choice: the role of total factor productivity
core_idea: Develop a theoretical model linking firms' ESG performance to their outward foreign direct investment (OFDI) mode choice by explaining how ESG influences corporate total factor productivity, and empirically test the model using data from Chinese listed companies while integrating ESG considerations into classical OLI theory and the productivity threshold of new-new trade theory.
tldr: Constructs and empirically tests a model that connects firm ESG performance to OFDI mode choice through its effect on total factor productivity, and situates ESG within OLI and new-new trade theory frameworks.
